summary: Harden #628/#630: decide_pending_plan (approve|revise|reject + archive), planning_feed_items (pending plans + incomplete sessions with ask_user_question), feed/CLI/MCP surfaces (plate_planning_decide, --list-pending/--decide/--feed).
migration_impact: New MCP tools plate_planning_decide and plate_planning_list_pending; CLI gh plate plan --decide/--list-pending/--feed. Pending plans always carry ask_user_question. Approve does not auto-create GitHub issues. No config break.
migration_guidance: 2. After plate_planning_build, present plan ask_user_question from feed or plan payload.
3. Human/host: plate_planning_decide plan_id approve|revise|reject (or gh plate plan --decide ID --decision approve).
4. On approve: agent creates GitHub stubs from plan body/labels; on revise: resume session_id.
agent_notes: Never create issues until plan status=approved. Feed ranks planning_approval ~16 and incomplete sessions ~22. Decided plans archive under .agentic/planning/decided/.
